title: Pixel-noir thriller about a radio host who receives his own death call from the future
author: One_Low8664
selftext:
[https://bug.games/games/dead-air](https://bug.games/games/dead-air)

The art brief: midnight-blue streets, sodium-orange lamps and bright red ON AIR signs. Cramped interiors full of ageing equipment, coffee rings and small signs of someone working through the night. Expressive pixel characters, scenes framed like tense film shots, and restrained animation interrupted by sudden movement.

I wanted the lighting and composition to create tension before anything happened.

The gameplay brief: inspect scenes, question people and connect evidence. Short rewinds let you use what you learned from a failed attempt. Radio interference carries clues as well as atmosphere.
